title: Special Executive Programme In Corporate Social Responsibility And Governance
description: The Special Executive Program in Corporate Social Responsibility and Governance aims to enable the learner with critical knowledge of structure and process of corporate governance and the concept of corporate social responsibility.
longDescription: The Special Executive Programme in Corporate Social Responsibility and Governance provides insights into the evolving role of CSR in business, including the concepts of corporate citizenship, social performance, and corporate governance structures. Participants will explore global reporting standards, the triple bottom line, and the key drivers shaping CSR strategies in organizations.
courseDetails: This programme covers essential aspects of CSR and corporate governance, with a focus on how companies integrate ethical, legal, and philanthropic responsibilities into their operations. Learners will explore the Global Reporting Initiative, corporate social performance, corporate citizenship development, and the drivers behind socially responsible investing. The course emphasizes the benefits of aligning CSR with governance reforms and business strategies to enhance social responsiveness and financial performance.
